name: General-Bench
description: General-Bench is a comprehensive evaluation suite encompassing over 700 tasks and 325,800 instances designed to assess multimodal large language models across a broad spectrum of skills, modalities, formats, and capabilities. It supports the General-Level framework which defines 5-scale levels of MLLM performance and generality, measuring synergy across comprehension and generation and multiple modalities.
reputation: A new large-scale multimodal benchmark that is gaining attention for its breadth, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Includes over 700 tasks and 325,800 instances; evaluates synergy and generality of multimodal LLMs.
